This small plot of 0.08 hectares is just a little piece near the house, and since it is intercropped with other crops, I will manage it simply with what I have. Chemical fertilizer is expensive and hard to find here in Mtwara, so I will rely on manure from my animals and kitchen waste instead. I will use my own saved seeds like always, and my wife and I will handle the work ourselves without hiring anyone for such a small patch. The rains should be enough — I have no pump or canal to irrigate.
